mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.PROD_ID)) FROM () A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON(A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02')) WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(B.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT prdRegistCode, prodId, prdVDate, holdDate, prdRaiseTotalQty, prdRaiseTotalAmt, investRaiseTotalQty, investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT tmp1.REG_CODE prdRegistCode, tmp1.PROD_ID as prodId, tmp1.VDATE prdVDate, STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AS holdDate, IFNULL(tmp1.RAISE_QTY,0) as prdRaiseTotalQty, IFNULL(tmp1.TOTAL_AMT,0) as prdRaiseTotalAmt, SUM(IFNULL(QTY,0)) as investRaiseTotalQty, SUM(IFNULL(CNY_AMT,0)) as investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT @rownum :=@rownum +1 rownum, A.PROD_ID, A.VDATE, A.RAISE_QTY, A.TOTAL_AMT, CASE WHEN B.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE B.CNY_AMT END CNY_AMT, CASE WHEN B.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE B.QTY END QTY, D.REG_CODE, IF ((@PROD_ID = A.PROD_ID AND @INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK), @rank :=@rank + 1, @rank :=1 ) AS investStatusNo, @PROD_ID := A.PROD_ID, @INDENTIFY_MARK := B.INDENTIFY_MARK FROM (SELECT * FROM () bb ORDER BY PROD_ID, INDENTIFY_MARK,UPDATE_TIME ) A, (SELECT @rownum :=0, @PROD_ID := NULL, @INDENTIFY_MARK := NULL, @rank := 0) tmp LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE D ON A.PROD_ID = D.PRODID INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(B.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) tmp1 WHERE investStatusNo = 1 GROUP BY tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.REG_CODE, tmp1.VDATE, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT ) tmp2 WHERE investRaiseTotalQty > 0 AND investRaiseTotalAmt > 0
